clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, Wizbang Cranktoggle's electropellers lie scattered in freshwater rivers after a failed night outing.

Wizbang Cranktoggle built the electropeller to propel an experimental exploding duck decoy. The gnome inventor works out of Auberdine. While scouting Darkshore's waterways after too many drinks, he blacked out. Hours later, he woke with singed hair and an empty pack. His electropellers had tumbled into Darkshore's freshwater currents, where they remain scattered through rivers and lakes until patient anglers recover them.
